works.body:
Nice to meet you!
I requested this because I was interested in your drawing pattern.
If you don't mind, would it be possible for me to ask you to draw our OC, "Rikuzuki Usagi"?
For your reference, the setting is as follows, but you can draw freely.
Mutsuki Usagi
Rikuzuki Usagi (陸月 兎子)

A girl with pigtails, black hair and eyes, and a hair dress decorated with stars.
She is curious and good-natured.

She always carries Boo, a white rabbit, with her.
She is the only one who can see Boo, and no one but Boo can touch him.

She has the ability to interfere with the world and time, and can find herself in another world line or another time axis that matches certain conditions and send images (limited to simple figures such as zeros and x's) telepathically.

It is difficult for the sender to send the image many times in a row because of the dramatic discomfort involved.
The recipient has no inbox or rejection settings, so he or she feels as if his or her consciousness is suddenly jammed. If a large number of messages are received simultaneously from different world lines or different time axes, the recipient will lose consciousness with a nosebleed.

She herself has no further special powers, but her companion Boo is no exception.
Boo, like her, has the ability to interfere with the world and time, but it is not just a matter of sending telepathic messages; the world (time) itself is randomly rewritten.
For example, it is possible to move between parallel worlds (world lines) and create/annihilate them (branching/integration), speed up (stop) the flow of time, or time leap to the past or future (time travel), etc. When these occur in complex and complicated ways, it is difficult to grasp the situation unless from the perspective of a deity.

Since Boo's intelligence is that of a 5-6 year old child, if left unchecked, he will use his abilities at will, and the way the world (time) is distorted without limit.
If the distortion becomes too severe, it will even affect another world line (time axis). If this happens, he will receive a large number of warnings from himself in another world line (time axis), so he has no choice but to keep an eye on Boo to prevent him from using his powers carelessly.

If Boo inadvertently uses his power, we will have no choice but to ask him to use his power several more times to correct the distortion, but since it is only an act of correcting distortion by distortion, it cannot be completely restored.

Since he is not known as a person of ability, no one has given him a second name. He calls himself "The Wizard of Time," "The Watcher," etc., but these are only self-proclaimed names.
He is a "wizard of time" and "watcher," but these are only self-proclaimed names.
I am planning to use this for all my personal activities (illustrations for novels, introduction of characters on SNS and personal websites, announcements of personal activities, etc.).
If it is convenient for you, I would appreciate it.
